demand.text: At kickoff the team's notable priorities were speaker shots from the podium and subwoofer, the amp, climbing alone or with partners, driving under the stage for faster cycles, an auto of four or more notes, and the trap, which leaves only one more robot needed onstage for the ranking point. It decided against shot blocking, buddy climbs and sliding along the chain.

auto.text: A routine is set up by answering questions such as start position and number of spike notes. A newer 'thinking on your feet' routine sweeps the center line until it gets a note, then shoots from the nearest scoring place. Localization brings the robot back to its path after contact.

cycle.text: A note enters under the bumper at the back, is centered by rollers, and passes a kicker roller into the indexer, which sends it to the shooter or to the amp backpack; the team can switch while the note is inside. For the amp, the arm raises as the note runs up and back down.

endgame.text: Arm and hooks go up, the robot drives under the stage and chain, the chain drops into the hooks, the arm moves forward and the hooks pull down. The backpack then extends to score the trap; pulsing rollers keep a missed note in place for another try.

fallback.text: If another team has taken center-line notes, the 'thinking on your feet' routine keeps sweeping; the team says it skipped notes that way in its last match.
The sweep also recovers when the robot misses a note.
A console switch turns off all auto alignment so the driver lines up by hand.

gave_up.text: The team planned to bolt systems to the outside or top of the drivetrain: a small hit to center of gravity, worth it for simpler, modular systems and an open belly pan.
In March it ran no game piece detection, expecting driver practice to do more for intaking.

changed.text: Hits damaged the shooter at both district events, so before the district championship it moved closer to the frame, with beater bars, and running current fell from about 30 A to 8 A. Fangs and a powered trap roller made climb and trap faster and more consistent. Wheels went from orange to blue stealth and back for far shots. For the championship, autos gained the center-line sweep.

outcome.text: 57-12-0 in official play; won the Hopper division; captain of the Hopper alliance on Einstein; ranked 7 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 56.85, Hopper).

solves.text: Deliver a centered note to the arm from a full-width opening

facts.text: On the back of the robot
Two leading rollers with small wedges start centering the note
Passive rollers with slippery tape finish centering
Lesson from an earlier four-roller intake prototype, later dropped: a bottom front roller is needed to kick the note up
Torque current of the spinning intake motor shows contact with a note
It saves about half a second or more over waiting for the sensor before the flywheels

solves.text: Turn back toward the speaker in auto as soon as a note is touched

functions.name: Dead-axle rollers
functions.type: polycarbonate tube rollers on stub axles

facts.text: 1 in outside diameter, 1/16 in wall polycarbonate tubes
The 3/8 in hex stub is left exposed for a wrench, so a roller changes with two bolts and nothing else comes apart
Each printed pulley plug holds two 10 x 19 x 5 mm bearings and bolts to the tube with heat-set inserts
Silicone sleeves for grip, except grip tape on the lowest intake roller, which runs over small things on the field
Blue threadlocker on both bolts and a lock washer on the outer one; the inner bolt did not back out

solves.text: Live axles would be hard to package, too heavy and hard to maintain with so many rollers

cost.text: Many rollers were replaced because the grip material broke, and pulley flanges sometimes broke, usually after taking in field tape
A different backpack roller with a full shaft and one bearing per end broke at the tube edge when slammed into the stage at the championship
The full-width bottom roller, 26 in long, wobbles some; for more speed the team would use a larger tube or a full shaft with a middle bearing

functions.name: Indexer

solves.text: Switch the note between two scoring paths at any time

functions.type: double-sided belt indexer with two exits

facts.text: A kicker roller feeds it
Double-sided belt reverses some rollers without gears, which helps packaging
Shuffles a note between the shooter path and the amp and trap path
The double-sided belt is d600-5m-09

cost.text: The belt came out loose, so idlers were resized and moved along the hole grid

solves.text: Survive rigorous defense and shoot from near the wing line

facts.text: Each side is driven separately at a different speed, to spin the note for stable flight
Orange stealth wheels
Motors sit far back on the arm, which lowers the center of gravity and arm inertia
An undated published commit, which includes demo modes, has a tunable left shooting speed with default
An undated published commit, which includes demo modes, has a tunable right shooting speed with default
It mounts on the inside face of the arm tube, so an assembled spare drops in
0.75 in outside diameter beater bars take the hard hits
Prototype: twelve 3 in stealth wheels, designed as 40A, with 0.5 in compression at about 6000 and 4000 rpm, made nearly all hand-loaded shots from about 15 ft
The tested prototype had 50A wheels on one side because that was on hand; the stickier ones went on the faster side
In prototyping, removing the middle wheels made shots more consistent
Prototype lesson: a consistent push from the feeder made a big difference, and shots not loaded perfectly varied
In March it ran 6000 rpm on one side and 4000 on the other, measured at the wheel
Geared up 1:2 so motors sit near maximum efficiency with headroom to hold speed
Spin-up takes about 1 s, so wheels pre-spin to 75% when a note is held, the speaker is within 25 ft and the robot is not climbing
Shoots on the move in auto; in teleop corrections are small, for shots before a full stop

cost.text: It was bent in collisions at both district events; a printed support block that the team added was shattered by a later hit, and spare blocks were on hand
Long belt runs had high friction, about 30 A to run, until the shooter moved in and it fell to 8 A

facts.text: Based on 1678's pivot, with parts spread out so motors and gears swap more easily
Ratio stated during the build on 2 February, about 93:1
Two Kraken X60s
Bearing blocks in the tubes are pulled up by bolts to tension the #35 chain, which was done about three times all year

cost.text: Tensioning moves the pivot itself, so one side may tighten about 1/8 in more and skew the shooter; the team had no issue with it

facts.text: An undated published commit holds one tunable shooting speed and sets arm angle in degrees as about 57.25 times distance in meters to the power -0.593, plus an adjustable correction
It aims for a predicted pose, with separate look-ahead times in auto and teleop
A separate long-distance mode has its own field target, with arm angle and wheel speed tables for about 26 to 34 ft, and corrects wheel speed for robot motion

cost.text: At Granite State the arm encoder shifted over time and backlash could not be accounted for, which affected speaker shots

functions.name: Auto align for amp and climb

facts.text: One held button drives the robot into place; the driver decides when to score
At the amp the arm raises itself within 5 ft and 120 degrees of the target
It drives straight to the pose on a trapezoid distance profile with a feedforward so it takes over smoothly at speed

solves.text: Make the ends of cycles simple and repeatable for the driver

cost.text: The amp alignment was poorly tuned at Granite State

functions.name: Amp Backpack

solves.text: Score amp and trap through a second path that does not use the shooter

functions.type: sliding carriage on top of the arm

facts.text: The note goes down, up, then back down into the amp while the arm raises
A rack and pinion extends it for the trap
Pulsing rollers hold a missed trap note for another try
A powered roller, belted to an existing one, replaced a lexan strip as trap flap
Reached after about 15 versions of routing the note
One motor and one gearbox power both sides through two sets of #25 chain
A 254:1 version was dropped as far more than needed; the plan became about 60:1 with a lockout at the bottom

solves.text: Keep the chain from catching in gaps of the shooter and backpack

facts.text: Prototyped in cardboard and wood on a laser cutter before the lexan version
The robot can drive under the stage with the arm partly up

functions.name: Localization

solves.text: Keep following an auto path after contact with another robot

functions.type: four AprilTag cameras on two Orange Pis

facts.text: The zoom lens camera sees the speaker tags from the wing and can be weighted about 40% more than the standard lenses
Two Orange Pis replaced four from the year before
Mounts are SLS-printed TPU
Three front cameras, two of 75 degrees and one 45 degree zoom, and one 90 degree camera at the back
OV2311 cameras at 1600x1200, two per Orange Pi 5, run at 20 to 30 frames per second
Cameras sit on the swerve modules and low on the superstructure, where their positions match CAD
For a single tag, solutions with over 40% of the error of the alternative are rejected, the one nearer the gyro heading is kept, and rotation is not updated
No tag placement issue significant enough to affect shots was found at Granite State, though some tags were visibly tilted

cost.text: Early in the season a timestamp error of up to a frame pulled the pose toward the speaker in fast autos until it was corrected

facts.text: Numerical optimization replaced spline generation, in a container reached over gRPC
The solver's module forces become torque feedforward, to match target acceleration as well as velocity
In the Granite State autos every step had a fixed length, so drive and note handling ran as separate sequences and a note was fed before the path ended
Over 100 trajectories are generated ahead of time, including returns sampled every 15 cm along the center-line sweep
The competition robot ran Krakens, planned in February as X60s for drive and steer with L3 gearing; the development robot used NEOs and L2 MK4i
An automatic routine spins the robot and uses the gyro to measure wheel radius, so it is redone often as tread wears
Module setpoints pass through 254's setpoint generator, so each module is only asked for what it can reach

cost.text: Supply current limits did not work in torque-current mode that season, so a stator limit was used against brownouts and overlapped with the setpoint generator

facts.text: CAD estimate of 3 February, before the amp backpack: center of gravity height above the floor with the arm down
CAD estimate of 3 February, before the amp backpack: center of gravity height above the floor with the arm up

solves.text: Let the robot drive hard: the team calls center of gravity one of the big drivers of the design, and being light very important

decisions.choice: Two note paths from one indexer
decisions.because: the team needs to switch between shooter and amp or trap whenever it wants
one half spinning faster spins the note and keeps its flight stable
it had been bent at both district events and needed to survive defense at the district and world championships
approaching from inside the stage with the arm rising let the chain catch after a slight positioning error
new autos needed shots from near the wing line
decisions.instead_of: blue stealth wheels, used for looks at one event

decisions.choice: Shooter mounted on the inside of the tube
decisions.because: a spare shooter can be dropped in quickly
decisions.instead_of: a plate inside a printed block in the tube, which packed well but was very difficult to pry out

decisions.because: powering and setting up four was really difficult
it gave drive practice and auto time early, and showed assembly mistakes to fix in the real design

decisions.choice: Pivot at the back of the shooter, with a separate intake
decisions.because: separating the systems cut complexity, mechanical conflicts and weight and made them modular
decisions.instead_of: a center-pivot shooter with an attached intake that extended out the back, shelved after a couple of weeks

decisions.because: the shooter would sit at the end of an arm, so size and weight mattered; speed can make up the difference
only one note is shot at a time, and a light wheel spins up from zero faster in auto

decisions.choice: Revise the shooter instead of rebuilding it
decisions.because: time and people were short, and a rebuild had to finish before the district championship to leave testing time
decisions.instead_of: a lighter shooter with double-sided belts and no reversing gear stage

decisions.choice: Run the arm profile on the roboRIO
decisions.because: a profile on the motor controller is hidden from logging, replay and simulation
decisions.instead_of: the motor controller's own motion profile

decisions.because: they leave space for partners scoring spike notes, and far notes should be contested less
dozens of paths made by a rule are not possible in a visual tool
cameras on the swerve modules get hit; its first rigid mounts, in an earlier season, broke about a set per driver practice, and a full 3D solve tolerates small shifts
driver practice should help intaking more; in March the team did not plan to work on choosing notes in auto before the district championship or championship, if at all
